---
title: Guides
description: One page per subsystem.
---

A guide covers one subsystem: its concepts, its design decisions, and short
code snippets. For complete programs, see [Examples](../examples/index.qmd).
For individual functions and classes, see the
[API reference](../reference/index.qmd).

| Guide | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| [Meshing](meshing.qmd) | Dual contouring from an SDF to a surface mesh, sharp features, export and mesh checks. |
| [Simulation](simulation.qmd) | Simulation meshes, thermal and elastic studies, node selections, results and solver backends. |
| [Optimization](optimization.qmd) | `Optimization` declarations, objectives, gradient paths through mesh and solver, and constraints. |
| [Plugins](plugins.qmd) | The plugin contract, configuration in `plugins.toml`, and writing and serving a plugin. |
| [Materials](materials.qmd) | The `Material` class, the material catalogue, material fields and mass. |
| [Rendering](rendering.qmd) | The JAX raymarcher, quality presets, materials, and compilation to WGSL. |
| [Flow solver (prototype)](flow.qmd) | Lattice Boltzmann flow on the SDF, conjugate heat transfer, and gradients. |

To install cadjoint and run a first model, see [Get started](getting-started.qmd).
